name: S*S 2 -W Dorei to Amaama Seiseikatsu-
original_name: S*S2-W奴隷とあまあま性生活-
source:
After the events of S*S, Yui and her abductor 
are close-knit lovers. It's time to take this slave relationship 
to a new level... Yui lures her best friend to be a co-slave! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE151948.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
在《S*S》的故事结束后，由衣与绑架她的人成了亲密恋人。现在，是时候让这段主奴关系更进一步了……由衣诱骗自己的好友，让她成为共同的奴隶！

（来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE151948.html]DLsite English[/url]）
